items.rationale: The separate cause-and-extent assessment is covered under 5.2.6(b), subject to the €3,000 cap. Estimated €500 gross before allocating a proportionate share of the single €500 event deductible across covered lines.

Section 5.2.6(a) covers locating the porous leaks; the estimated €460 detection charge and €170 technician charge together stay below the €1,000 event cap. The estimate reflects the allocated event deductible.

Section 5.2.6(a) covers on-site technician time to the extent it is not already included in the detection fee. Estimated 2.5 hours at €68 gross, or €170 before the allocated deductible, within the shared €1,000 cap.
Section 5.2.6(c) permits one vehicle charge on this contractor's invoice, capped at €83.30 gross (€70 net plus 19% VAT). Estimated €80 gross before the allocated deductible.

items.description: Repair of two actively leaking copper joints
items.rationale: Section 2.4.3(a) treats ageing-related leakage as fracture damage for the sections shown to be leaking; 9.1.1 does not treat ordinary ageing alone as a duty breach. Estimated €300 gross for the two local repairs before the allocated deductible.

items.description: Precautionary replacement of non-leaking copper run
items.rationale: Sections 2.4.3(a) and 7.1.5 exclude sections not shown to be leaking, even when replaced during a covered repair. The positive figure is a conditional placeholder, not a recommended payment.
Section 7.1.9 limits indemnity to the pre-loss standard, and this line bills only the upgrade difference. The positive figure is a conditional placeholder, not a recommended payment.

The visit served the covered joint repairs, so 5.2.6(c) permits one charge on the plumber's invoice despite the elective work done on the same visit. Estimated €80 gross before the allocated deductible, below the €83.30 gross cap.
